worldcombat.skill.guardswap.summary: Use psychic power to switch the Defense and Sp. Def stat changes of both sides for a window: you take the guard the foe has raised, and both return when the window ends. Pokemon use the native ladder, other bodies the shared one.
worldcombat.skill.guardswap.use.0: Take the Defense and Sp. Def the foe has raised
worldcombat.skill.guardswap.use.1: Dump your own lowered Defense onto the foe
worldcombat.skill.guardswap.use.2: Borrow the foe's wall for one round
Switch Defense and Sp. Def stat changes with a target within %1$s blocks, held for %2$s; a clear line is required.

Only the steps each side has already built are switched: the thicker the foe's guard, the more you gain, and your own steps land on them. Both return to their old stages when the window ends or is cleared.
worldcombat.skill.guardswap.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP to switch, then %3$s seconds to recover and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.guardswap.growth.0: At level %1$s the switch reaches %2$s blocks and the window lasts %3$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.guardswap.growth.1: At level %1$s the switch reaches %2$s blocks and the window lasts %3$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.guardswap.preference.a: The companion only switches when the threat is within this distance; lower stays close, higher chases the guard farther out.
The foe's combined Defense and Sp. Def stages must exceed yours by this many steps. Higher is pickier; lower casts more often.
On: it leaves its station under a hold order to switch. Off: it only casts when the target is already in reach.
